title: Recording setup and a note on Sidney Lansfield
summary: Machine test with location and date, then Edwards names Sidney Lansfield as a substitute in 1917 when Ragas was ill.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: According at 6th Amsterdam. I'm just testing the machine, huh? According at 6th Amsterdam Avenue, New York City, July the 1st, 1959.
Going? Go right ahead. Just leave it there.
Make sure you've got a balance, huh?
Sidney Lansfield, a celebrated movie director for Adolph Zucca, and who substituted in the original Dixieland Jazz Band in 1917, when Henry Ragus was ill in New Orleans for two weeks.
